title: Chapter 612 - 612 Building; Little Thunderclap Monastery!
content:
Chapter 612 - 612 Building; Little Thunderclap Monastery!

Chapter 612 - 612 Building; Little Thunderclap Monastery!

612 Building; Little Thunderclap Monastery!

Naturally, Lin Fan did not know that his name was already affiliated to roasted meat.

After a full meal, the sky turned completely dark.

The hotter the desert was during the day, the colder it would be at night.

In the vast desert, a gust of wind blew, and they trembled.

“There doesn’t seem to be any cover nearby,” Abraham said.

“Lin Fan, you sleep first. I’ll keep watch.”

Sleeping in the desert was very dangerous.

Especially the forbidden desert.

No one knew if there would be a sudden sandstorm.

If that happened, all those who were sleeping would probably be buried alive.

No one knew if a terrifying monster would suddenly appear.

In that case, everyone who slept might directly become food.

Therefore, generally speaking, night watch was very necessary.

While others slept, the night watchers had to stay awake in the cold desert.

There was no doubt that the night watchers had a hard time.

However, Abraham took the initiative to embrace it.

“There’s no need to keep watch,” said Lin Fan.

Then, he stood up and drew a 300-square-meter circle around him.

[Skill: Draw a Circle as Your Home!]

Instantly, the cold wind in the desert seemed to have stopped.

The temperature started to rise.

Just as Abraham was confused, Lin Fan took out three sleeping bags.

“Go to sleep.”

Abraham widened his eyes again and said in disbelief, “These are… sleeping bags?

“Oh my god!

“Where did you get them?

“Your magic tricks are amazing!”

“This is kung fu!” Sam corrected. “Hua kung fu!”

Lin Fan did not explain further and went into his sleeping bag.

Tonight, he slept very soundly.

The sleeping bag was warm and comfortable, and the desert made the sleeping bag even softer.

…

In the blink of an eye, it was the second day.

The sun seemed to have been fueled up, and soon, the entire desert became extremely hot.

The air… started to twist again.

Lin Fan, the Heavenly Hound, Sam, and Abraham headed into the unknown.

At this moment, a crisp notification rang out in Lin Fan’s mind.

[Ding! You’ve been in the Otherworld for 864 hours. You’ve obtained 600 Constitution points.]

His strength increased once again.

Three people and a dog walked around during the day, ate meat, and slept at night. They lived a very comfortable life.

…

In the blink of an eye, five days had passed.

In these five days, they had encountered three monsters and Lin Fan had killed them all easily. He had gained 10,000 Constitution points and 6,000 points of spiritual energy.

Every single day, Lin Fan’s strength would skyrocket.

…

In Hua Nation’s live broadcast room.

Candle in the Wind: [Although I’ve been looking at the desert for a few days, I don’t feel sick of it at all. It’s still so beautiful!]

Qingchun: [I think it’s beautiful too.]

Tian Tian: [But the desert is so dangerous.]

Shangshan Ruoshui: [It’s really dangerous! I just watched other broadcasts. A few heroes from Country F, Country M, and Country A have been eaten by monsters in the desert. It’s too terrifying.]

Future: [In the desert, there is nothing but sand… It’s too easy for monsters to hide.]

123: [F*ck! The hero of Franks Nation has just seen a building in the desert. However, before he could enter, he was eaten by a snake.]

Just Love You: [I saw it too!]

Chunchun: [Could it be a mirage?]

Feng: [Are you talking about the one in front?]

Sweating: [F*ck! God Lin has also encountered that building!]

…

Sam, who was walking in the desert, shouted, “Master, there seems to be a building ahead!”

In fact, he did not need to say anything.

Lin Fan had seen it long ago.

However, he did not pay too much attention to it.

Not only did he see it, but he also saw that… the shape of this building was a little like a temple.

“There are buildings in the desert?” Abraham was surprised.”

“Could it be a mirage?”

“However, isn’t this the Otherworld? There shouldn’t be a mirage of such a building, right?”

At this moment, the Heavenly Hound suddenly let out a loud cry.

Lin Fan understood what it meant.

“There’s something up ahead!”

In the next moment, a giant golden python that was several meters thick dashed out.

A terrifying baleful aura spread out, causing one’s heart to tremble.

Then, the snake opened its ferocious teeth and pounced on everyone, as if it wanted to swallow everyone in one fell swoop.

Regarding this…

Lin Fan did not even lift his eyelids as he pulled out his sword.

A crescent-shaped sword light shot out.

In the next moment…

The head of the golden python fell on the desert with a dull thud like a boulder rolling down a mountain.

Blood spurted out!

No matter how strong a demon was, it would not be able to block any of Lin Fan’s attacks.

Then, an emotionless voice sounded.

[The first to kill a level-seven Golden Python. You’ve obtained a level-seven treasure chest.]

[The first to kill a level-seven Golden Python. You’ve reduced Hua Nation’s pollution by 10%.]

Lin Fan opened the treasure chest.

[600 points of spiritual energy. Do you want to use them?]

A pleasant notification immediately sounded in his mind.

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received 6,000 points of spiritual energy.]

Lin Fan casually threw the ball of light into the Heavenly Hound’s body.

Then, the group continued to walk forward.

After a while, they arrived in front of an ancient and dilapidated building.

The building had a shadow.

It was not a mirage!

It was a building that really existed in the desert!

It was simply unbelievable!

Lin Fan raised his head slowly.

The next moment, he was slightly stunned.

That was because there was an ancient plaque hanging above the building.

On the plaque, there were a few traditional Hua characters: [Little Thunderclap Monastery!]

…

In Hua Nation’s live broadcast room.

Xiao Bing covered her mouth and said, “Little Thunderclap Monastery? What’s going on?”

The comments in the live broadcast room were like a torrential rain that completely filled the entire screen.

Cold Salad: [F*ck!]

Misaka Mikoto: [F*ck!]

Shangguan Ming: [F*ck!]

Speed Examiner: [F*ck!]

…

After a while, other comments appeared on the screen.

Jiang Chen: [Aren’t God Lin and the others in the forbidden area of the Otherworld? Why are there Hua characters?]

Wind’s Worry, Cloud’s Worry: [Little Thunderclap Monastery? Wasn’t this the temple in Journey to the West?]

Red swelling: [Could it be that the Otherworld is the world of the West?]

World Unification: [Hiss! Those mythological stories are about the Otherworld?]

Human Beings Were Originally Good: [F*ck! If the Otherworld is Journey to the West, then does that mean we weren’t reading fairy tales but historical records?]

Faint Tea Fragrance: [If that’s the case, do all the people in the myths and legends also exist? There’s the grand supreme elder? The Jade Emperor? Even Sun Wukong?]

Hello Tomorrow: [My blood is suddenly boiling!]]

Rice Noodle: [Do you think God Lin will meet Buddha in Little Thunderclap Monastery later?]

Honest: [This… That shouldn’t be possible, right? Moreover, Little Thunderclap Monastery seemed to be a calamity and trap in Journey to the West.]
